notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key for the person table.
Data release cycle indicator. Stored as an observation with observation_concept_id representing 'Data release number' (non-standard).
Interview/examination status. Maps to observation; codes 1=Interviewed Only, 2=Both. Use custom concept or source value.
Six-month exam period (Nov-Apr vs May-Oct). Stored as observation; no standard concept for seasonality of exam.
Gender: 1=Male (8507), 2=Female (8532). Map directly to gender_concept_id using standard OMOP gender concepts.
Age in years at screening. Use to derive year_of_birth (screening year - age). Topcoded at 85.
Age in months at screening for those <85. Stored as observation; can be used to refine year_of_birth or month_of_birth.
Age in months at exam. Stored as observation; useful for temporal alignment of measurements.

Race/Ethnicity recode. 1=Mexican American, 2=Other Hispanic, 3=Non-Hispanic White, 4=Non-Hispanic Black, 5=Other/Multi-Racial. Maps to race_concept_id (Hispanic groups also map to ethnicity_concept_id=Hispanic).
Veteran/military status. Yes/No/Refused/Don't know. Stored as observation with concept for 'Military service status'.
Country of birth recode (US, Mexico, Elsewhere). Stored as observation; can be linked to location_id for country of birth.
US citizenship status. Stored as observation with concept for 'Citizenship status'.
Length of time in US (categorical). Stored as observation; no standard concept, use custom categories.
Education level for children/youth 6-19. Stored as observation with concept for 'Education level'.
Education level for adults 20+. Stored as observation with concept for 'Education level'.
Current school attendance status. Stored as observation.
Marital status. Stored as observation with concept for 'Marital status'.
Total number of people in household. Stored as observation with concept for 'Household size'.
Total number of people in family. Stored as observation with concept for 'Family size'.
Annual household income (bracketed). Stored as observation with concept for 'Annual household income'.
Annual family income (bracketed). Stored as observation with concept for 'Annual family income'.
Family poverty income ratio (PIR). Continuous value; stored as observation with concept for 'Poverty income ratio'.
Pregnancy status at exam. Stored as observation with concept for 'Pregnancy status'.
Gender of household reference person. Not directly mapped to the sample person's record; skip or store in observation if needed for family-level analysis.
Age of household reference person. Not directly mapped to the sample person; skip or store as observation for family context.
Country of birth of household reference person. Not directly mapped to the sample person; skip or store as observation.
Education level of household reference person. Not directly mapped to the sample person; skip or store as observation.
Marital status of household reference person. Not directly mapped to the sample person; skip or store as observation.
Education level of household reference person's spouse. Not directly mapped to the sample person; skip or store as observation.
Language of SP interview (English/Spanish). Stored as observation with concept for 'Language used'.
Proxy used in SP interview. Stored as observation with concept for 'Proxy respondent'.
Interpreter used in SP interview. Stored as observation with concept for 'Interpreter used'.
Language of family interview. Stored as observation.
Proxy used in family interview. Stored as observation.
Interpreter used in family interview. Stored as observation.
Language of MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Proxy used in MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Interpreter used in MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Language of ACASI interview. Stored as observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight. Stored as observation with concept for 'Survey weight'.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight. Stored as observation with concept for 'Survey weight'.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU. Stored as observation for design-based variance estimation metadata.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum. Stored as observation for design-based variance estimation metadata.
